summary: Martin Marietta Materials Inc. files Form 8-K disclosing amendments to its $800M revolver and a new $1.5B term loan facility to fund cash consideration for its previously announced acquisition of Lhoist North America, Inc. The credit agreements include a temporary leverage covenant step-up to 4.75x post-closing, stepping down to 3.75x. The term loan matures in three years with SOFR- or base-rate-based pricing. No per-share price, premium, or advisor named. Watch for regulatory clearances and closing conditions; risk-arb focuses on leverage and financing execution.
